baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct أَصْحَابُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ joins a plural relation noun to a noun of side and orientation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The companionship branch makes membership a sustained association, while the right-side branch supplies its axis. The phrase therefore classifies by durable side-affiliation rather than by a momentary location.

activation_trace.role: Sustained companionship turns أصحاب into a relational company whose members remain attached to a shared pole.
The right hand and right side give الميمنة a concrete directional pole for that continuing affiliation.

changed_reading.before: A bare deictic label: those are the people placed on the right.
changed_reading.after: A durable company whose identity is formed by continuing attachment to the right-hand side.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أصحاب can image accompaniment that keeps safe, and الميمنة can image blessing rather than geometry alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: Protective accompaniment and auspicious blessing combine into a condition of being kept in beneficent company. This reading coexists with the spatial one: rightness is experienced as a sheltering relation, not merely assigned as a coordinate.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment makes the company an active medium of keeping, calm, and aid.
Blessing and good fortune supply the favorable condition sustained by that accompaniment.

changed_reading.before: The group merely receives a favorable title.
changed_reading.after: They are a company held within protective accompaniment whose shared condition is blessing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots permit an active relation: something may be taken along as a fitting companion, and the right hand may signify power, restraint, and rightful force.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of naming passive occupants of a side, the phrase can name people whose companionship carries a fitting form of rightful power. The oddity is useful because it makes rightness a manner of bearing force rather than a badge.

activation_trace.role: Taking or making something accompany another supplies the active carrying relation in أصحاب.
Right-hand power, restraint, and rightful force identify what is carried and how the company is tested.

changed_reading.before: Rightness is a static place occupied by a fortunate group.
changed_reading.after: Rightness is a form of power carried as a fitting companion, making the group an active ethical alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath activates the otherwise latent oath sense of the focus-side noun. With أصحاب retaining sustained association, the right-hand company becomes a pledged company: its cohesion may be covenantal as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: Close association supplies the people who can be held together by a shared pledge.
The right-hand oath turns الميمنة into a possible pledge-bearing term rather than only a side name.
An oath apportioned among its people supplies the opening covenantal trigger and a social distribution mechanism.

structural_cues: An oath opens the sequence long before the deictic أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ identifies the focus company.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening q-s-m oath and a y-m-n oath branch; I infer that the oath can bind the later company. The live alternative is that the oath only frames the discourse while الميمنة remains spatial or auspicious.

changed_reading.before: Those attached to the favorable or right-hand side.
changed_reading.after: Those held together as companions of a right-hand pledge, with side, blessing, and covenant all still available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Apportionment, bounded territory, and release from prohibition form a civic-juridical mechanism. The focus company can consequently be heard as an allotted constituency aligned with the rightful side inside a contested boundary, not just an after-the-fact crowd.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association gives the allotted persons the coherence of a civic body.
The side of rightful force supplies the juridical orientation of the constituency.
Separating and allotting a share supplies the classificatory act by which a company is assigned.
A bounded tract of land supplies the civic container within which side-membership can matter.
The dissolution of a prohibition introduces legal release as a way a bounded order can be reconfigured.

structural_cues: The same city is named in two consecutive ayat, with حِلّ placed inside the second bounded-city statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allotment, a delimited land, and a lifted restriction; I infer a legal act that constitutes a right-aligned body. The alternative is three independent images serving oath, place, and permission without defining the focus group.

changed_reading.before: A company already found on the right side.
changed_reading.after: A civic body constituted by allotment, boundary, and lawful release toward the side of rightful force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parent-and-offspring frame activates the focus branch in which a son matures into a companion. Blessed company can thus be intergenerational: dependence ripens into reciprocal presence rather than lineage functioning only as descent.

activation_trace.role: A son growing old enough to become a companion supplies a temporal model for how company comes into being.
Blessing marks the matured intergenerational relation as a live reading of الميمنة.
Offspring from a line of descent activates generation as the source from which companionship may mature.

structural_cues: The paired nominal and verbal forms place parent and what is born in one compact generative frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parenthood, offspring, and the focus image of a son becoming a companion; I infer a dependency-to-reciprocity arc. The alternative is that 90:3 invokes generation generally without specifying the social mechanism of 90:18.

changed_reading.before: A blessed cohort whose members simply share a destination.
changed_reading.after: A blessed company that can be generated when inherited dependency matures into reciprocal companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation followed by centered struggle turns rightness into an embodied orientation maintained under load. Companionship is no longer merely co-location; it is the carrying of a fitting rightward alignment through the body's difficult center.

activation_trace.role: Making something fit and accompany supplies the carried alignment that persists through strain.
The bodily right side supplies a concrete orientation rather than an abstract favorable label.
Measured formation supplies a calibrated body in which directional alignment can be enacted.
Struggle and arduous exertion make maintaining that alignment costly rather than automatic.
The middle or heart of a thing locates struggle at an embodied center from which right and left diverge.

structural_cues: Creation, the human being, and كَبَد occur in a single predication immediately after the generative frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, hardship, and a central bodily image; I infer that right-side affiliation is practiced under centered load. The alternative is that كبد means hardship only and does not spatialize the focus phrase.

changed_reading.before: The company is deposited on a favorable side.
changed_reading.after: The company carries a rightward bodily fit through centered struggle, making orientation an achieved posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated suppositions of being unconstrained and unseen set solitary power against companionship. The right-hand force model changes accordingly: rightful capacity belongs to a visible, answerable company, while imagined isolation is the false mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Close association opposes the actor's fantasy of acting as an isolated, unanswerable unit.
Right-hand power and restraint make accountability a test of how capacity is held.
Supposition supplies the mistaken internal model of invulnerability that the focus company reverses.
Effective capacity supplies the power whose imagined limitlessness must be corrected.
Singularity and separation expose the solitary premise opposed by أصحاب.
Seeing by eye or insight restores visibility and answerability to conduct.

structural_cues: Two parallel أَيَحْسَبُ questions surround the expenditure boast and negate both unconstrained power and unseen action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mistaken supposition, capacity, singularity, and sight; I infer that companionship is the social form of accountable power. The alternative is exclusively divine surveillance, with no claim about relations among the focus group.

changed_reading.before: A fortunate group possessing superior power.
changed_reading.after: A company whose power is right because it accepts limit, visibility, and relation instead of solitary impunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exhausted wealth and material piled layer over layer activate the carrying sense of companionship. أصحاب can momentarily image people accompanied by what their expenditure has attached to them: a material record whose rightness depends on how capacity moved, not on the size of the pile.

activation_trace.role: Taking something along as a companion anchors the idea that acts and their material effects remain attached to actors.
Rightful capacity supplies the criterion by which the attached expenditure record is evaluated.
Exhausting effort or substance turns the boast into a claim about what has been spent away.
Possessing and multiplying wealth supplies the material capacity whose movement leaves a record.
Matter layered one part over another supplies the image of accumulated consequence rather than a neutral quantity.

structural_cues: The first-person boast about consumed wealth stands between paired questions about power and being seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spent capacity and layered matter; I infer that expenditure leaves an accompanying material trace. The alternative is that لبدًا only exaggerates quantity and never modifies the semantics of أصحاب.

changed_reading.before: Companions are only other persons sharing a side.
changed_reading.after: The right-side people are also those accompanied by an attached material history of how their capacity was spent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Endowed bilateral perception, gentle guidance, and two elevations convert the focus-side into a route. The company is formed by repeatedly taking and carrying one path, so rightness is trajectory and attachment rather than an unexplained sorting outcome.

activation_trace.role: Taking something along or fitting with it makes companionship a sustained route attachment.
The right side gives the chosen route a directional identity.
Setting something into a condition frames the faculties as enabling endowments rather than accidental anatomy.
The seeing eye supplies perception capable of orienting between alternatives.
Gentle direction toward a path or truth supplies the movement from capacity to orientation.
Elevation and high ground materialize the two alternatives as routes that must be climbed.

structural_cues: Paired eyes and lips precede the explicitly dual النجدين, creating a repeated bilateral architecture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired faculties, guidance, and two elevations; I infer that right-side affiliation is generated by maintained route choice. The alternative is a general two-path contrast with no special anatomical or companionship mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A durable attachment to a side already assigned.
changed_reading.after: A company continually formed by carrying the rightward route with endowed perception and guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gifted organs of speech become functional when the later doubled reciprocal counsel sends endurance and mercy from member to member. أصحاب الميمنة is thereby a communication circuit that companions people into blessing rather than a collection of independently qualified individuals.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment names the keeping effect produced by the reciprocal speech circuit.
Blessing is recast as a condition circulated and sustained among companions.
The tongue as a means of delivering a message supplies the transmission channel.
Speech passed from lip to lip supplies person-to-person relay rather than solitary utterance.
Exchanged counsel among a people closes the relay into a reciprocal social mechanism.
Bearing responsibility and staying with it gives the circuit durable load-bearing content.
Tender mercy supplies the other message whose circulation makes accompaniment protective.

structural_cues: Tongue and lips appear before the path test; تَوَاصَوْا is then repeated twice immediately before the deictic focus verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies message organs, lip-to-lip transfer, repeated mutual counsel, endurance, and mercy; I infer a feedback network that produces the company. The alternative is that the organs are generic gifts and the later counsel merely lists individual virtues.

changed_reading.before: People share blessing because each separately belongs to the right.
changed_reading.after: People become the blessed company by repeatedly accompanying one another through transmitted endurance and mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The difficult incursion, steep obstacle, and opening of a captive neck reverse the ordinary image of power. Rightful force proves itself by crossing resistance in order to unbind another; protective companionship is the social result of release.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment identifies the relation into which the released person can be restored.
Rightful force supplies the power whose direction is revised from domination toward release.
Entering hardship without protective hesitation supplies the costly motion required to confront constraint.
The steep, difficult rise materializes resistance rather than treating rightness as effortless status.
Releasing a pledge or neck from confinement supplies the decisive reversal from force-over to force-for.
The neck supplies the embodied captive whose restoration makes the power relation concrete.

structural_cues: The failed ascent is followed by a question and then by the compact nominal answer فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hazardous entry, a steep barrier, and release from confinement; I infer that these specify how right-hand power becomes rightful. The alternative is that emancipation is one meritorious act without redefining the focus-side.

changed_reading.before: The right-hand company possesses force and protection.
changed_reading.after: It becomes right-hand company by spending force to open confinement and return a captive body to protective relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Feeding amid exhausting hunger, attending to a child cut off from a keeper, and reaching the dust-bound poor make protective accompaniment into social infrastructure. The lineage baseline is revised: blessed company is generated by repairing broken dependence and widening kin-nearness through provision.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies the keeping relation that food and care materially enact.
Blessing becomes a circulated social condition rather than privately held good fortune.
Giving food to another supplies the concrete transfer by which accompaniment preserves life.
Hunger compounded by exhaustion supplies the pressure under which protective company becomes necessary.
A child severed from a keeper supplies the broken relation that companionship must repair.
Kinship proximity makes inherited relation an obligation rather than an entitlement.
The abasement of destitution supplies a second form of damaged social standing beyond orphanhood.
Poverty figured as adhesion to dust grounds the care mechanism at the lowest material level.

structural_cues: The alternatives move from releasing a neck to feeding, then name a near orphan and a dust-bound poor person as paired recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies food transfer, famine, severed guardianship, kin proximity, abasement, and dust poverty; I infer that repairing dependence constitutes the company itself. The alternative is that these are external proofs of membership rather than its relational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Blessed company may arise when natural lineage matures into companionship.
changed_reading.after: Blessed company is made by repairing severed care, converting kinship into responsibility, and extending protection to the socially grounded poor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate syntactic mirror repeats أصحاب while replacing the focus pole with the left/ill-fortune pole. Companionship is therefore a valence-neutral structure of durable affiliation, while the paired side nouns carry both spatial and auspicious polarity.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies the repeated relational frame shared by both poles.
The right side establishes one half of the explicit spatial opposition.
Blessing preserves the auspicious valence that coexists with the spatial right.
The repeated companionship noun proves that durable affiliation itself does not determine favorable valence.
The left side supplies the geometrical counter-pole to the focus right side.
Ill fortune supplies the negative valence countering the blessing branch of الميمنة.

structural_cues: Two adjacent ayat use the same أصحاب-plus-pole construction with opposed pole nouns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact relational mirror and both spatial and fortune branches; I infer a two-axis polarity held inside one syntax. The alternative is a purely moral pair of conventional labels with no live geometry or branch interaction.

changed_reading.before: Right side and blessing blur into one favorable designation.
changed_reading.after: The phrase operates on two coexisting axes—right versus left and blessing versus ill fortune—while أصحاب marks durable affiliation on either side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covering of a visible sign is followed by fire closed over its people. That sequence supports an abductive reversal: chosen covering becomes imposed enclosure. Against it, the focus companionship can be heard as protective rather than trapping, and blessed rightness as remaining open to what is shown.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies the non-trapping form of being held with others.
Blessing supplies the favorable alternative to an enclosure that closes over its occupants.
Blocking or veiling truth supplies the initial act of covering in the reversal.
A manifest sign supplies the visible object that is covered despite being available to perception.
Kindled fire supplies the hostile medium that comes to surround the counter-company.
Closing tightly over something completes the reversal from covering a sign to being covered by consequence.

structural_cues: Denial of signs and the sealed fire occur in consecutive clauses, with عَلَيْهِمْ placing the enclosure over the people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a covered truth, a manifest sign, kindled fire, and closure; I supply the directional reversal from chosen covering to imposed enclosure. The alternative is a simple punishment sequence without lexical reciprocity or implications for the focus company.

changed_reading.before: The right-side company is protected and fortunate in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: Its protective openness contrasts with a counter-company whose covering of visible signs returns as a trapping enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare focus branch in which dying is imaged by being laid on the right side, then lets the birth and final-fire frame span a whole life. It remains anchored directly in الميمنة and in the packet's birth-to-terminal sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a mortuary undertone, not as the phrase's primary translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rare death-on-the-right branch of ي م ن is grammatically lodged in الميمنة, while أصحاب supplies the company whose life-course reaches that posture.

activation_trace.role: Continuing companionship supplies the collective whose shared orientation can persist to death.
Dying as being laid on the right side supplies the unusual mortuary sense directly anchored in the focus noun.
The event of birth supplies the opening temporal edge of the proposed life-course frame.
The terminal kindled fire supplies an end-state context that makes a mortuary echo audible.

changed_reading.before: A social and moral company aligned with the right.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a birth-to-death company whose rightward alignment culminates in the body's final right-side posture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it joins accumulated wealth and feeding to the non-dominant و ص د image of a stone store for wealth in a mountain. It remains anchored through the focus branches of carrying accompaniment and blessing, and every context link is packet-backed; downstream prose should qualify the sealed-hoard contrast as a material analogy rather than claim that مؤصدة lexically means hoarding here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أصحاب can image carrying something along, while الميمنة can image blessing; together they can host a question about whether material blessing circulates or is sealed away.

activation_trace.role: Carrying something along supplies the material-transport relation by which wealth can enter company.
Blessing supplies the value that can either circulate through care or be immobilized as possession.
Accumulating wealth supplies the material stock whose social movement is at issue.
Layered matter supplies the image of a pile becoming increasingly immobile.
Feeding another supplies the opposite motion: stock leaves the pile and becomes sustaining relation.
The non-dominant stone store for wealth in a mountain supplies the sealed-hoard counterimage without replacing the surface sense of closure.

changed_reading.before: Blessed company is a static favorable state unrelated to material flow.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, blessed company is the circulation of carried wealth into sustenance, opposed by the image of accumulated value sealed in stone.

strongest_changes: The phrase shifted from a static destination label to a durable relation repeatedly made through route choice, accountable power, release, and care.
The steep-pass sequence revised right-hand force most sharply: power becomes rightful when it opens confinement and restores protective company.
Tongue, lips, and doubled reciprocal counsel turned companionship into a speech-mediated feedback network that circulates endurance and mercy.
The mirrored أصحاب construction preserved both spatial right-versus-left and blessing-versus-ill-fortune readings instead of forcing one sense.
The opening oath kept a distinct covenantal reading alive: a company bound by a right-hand pledge.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots behaved less like fixed labels than like relational operators. Context repeatedly changed what could be accompanied, carried, protected, allotted, released, or enclosed, allowing sworn, civic, intergenerational, embodied, economic, social, and terminal readings to coexist without merging them.
remaining_uncertainties: The relative weight of spatial right, blessing, oath, and rightful force in الميمنة remains deliberately unresolved.
The civic-allotment and attached-material-record models are well anchored by branches but depend on stronger reader-supplied causal arrows than the route and care models.
The reversal from covering signs to being enclosed is abductively coherent but may be rhetorical sequence rather than an intended lexical feedback.
The mortuary and sealed-hoard outliers should remain contained lexical undertones because they rely on a rare focus branch and a non-dominant mapped branch respectively.
